scientific_question: On the four already-open, preregistered worst-condition 5/7/9/12-camera cells, can the exact deployment-visible CGLS-K1 detector dual replace the invalid stacked v131 learned proposal when generating the pair-depth basis, while the single fixed projection-only target yields a literal warm initializer whose one unchanged restarted CGLS step remains within 1.05 of Zero-CGLS K4 on all four physical metrics?

decision_context.v140_4_fixed_primary_capacity: independently validated 3700/3700 and 5/5 with the old observation-only learned proposal in the basis
decision_context.v141_3_invalidity: Before any v141.3 feature, fit, prediction, score or validation output, a result-blind audit found that precomputed v131 leave-one-trajectory-out predictions are not end-to-end outer-fold isolated when reused as second-stage fit inputs: each fit-row upstream model may have trained on the new outer-heldout trajectory.
decision_context.aborted_partial_teacher: The v141.2 complete teacher had 1338/3700 partial rows and no READY or independent validation when its only valid consumer was removed. The partial output is permanently non-scientific and may not be resumed, scored or published.
decision_context.strategy_change: Remove the learned upstream feature entirely. The K1 detector dual is produced by the same exact K1 recurrence already required by the candidate and obeys A^T z1 = x1, so it adds no online A/A^T call and has no fold leakage path.

scientific_boundary: This is a post-open four-cell capacity sentinel, not a learned predictor, complete-trajectory result, fresh result, external generalization, resource speedup, curved-ray validation, real BOST evidence or paper success.

decision_rule.pass: Only if the independent validator rebuilds all four cells and warm_restart_k1 passes all four metrics in all four cells may a separate full-3700 K1-dual capacity protocol be frozen. This is not predictor or algorithm authorization.
decision_rule.fail: Any primary cell failure closes this K1-dual proposal substitution under the fixed objective. Do not run all 3700 cells and do not rescue it with a larger neural model.
decision_rule.control_interpretation: If a same-cost deterministic control passes every sentinel cell, report it. It does not replace the primary decision, but it blocks any later learned-advantage claim unless the learned route beats it under the complete gate.
decision_rule.inconclusive: Any provenance, source closure, non-finite value, call receipt, formal-independent physical mismatch or execution failure is inconclusive and authorizes no larger run.
